Current technical route
💵 Paper
Stables
🏦 Deposit Fiat 💳 Buy USDT 🌉 Bridge ⚡ Buy MINIMA 📱 Withdraw ✨ Mint Stables 🔥 Burn Stables 📥 CEX / DEX 📤 Sell MINIMA 🌉 Bridge 🔀 USDT → Fiat 🏧 Withdraw Fiat

On-Ramp (Paper Money → Stables)

1
🏦 Deposit Fiat
Deposit fiat in one of the partner exchanges (via bank or card).
2
💳 Buy USDT
Trade your deposited fiat for USDT on the exchange.
3
🌉 Optional Bridge
Bridge USDT to MxUSDT via mxusd.global if required by your venue.
4
⚡ Buy MINIMA
Trade your USDT for MINIMA on a CEX or the Minima DEX (see the list of venues above).
5
📱 On-chain Withdrawal
Send MINIMA to your Stables wallet address.
6
✨ Mint Stables
Convert your MINIMA into Stables tokens directly in the app.

Off-Ramp (Stables → Paper Money)

1
🔥 Burn to MINIMA
Burn your Stables tokens to reclaim native MINIMA on-chain.
2
📥 CEX / DEX
Deposit to CEX, or use DEX directly from your wallet.
3
📤 Sell MINIMA
Trade for USDT on a CEX, or MxUSDT on the DEX (see venues above).
4
🌉 Optional Bridge
Bridge MxUSDT to USDT via mxusd.global (skip if already on CEX).
5
🔀 USDT to Fiat
Sell USDT for fiat currency on the exchange.
6
🏧 Withdraw Fiat
Withdraw fiat directly to your bank or card.

The Stables Academy
Learn to be your own bank

Being your own bank is a skill, and this is where you learn it. Each topic is a short questionnaire you can take at your own pace and retake any time. Pass a topic and its star fills in, building toward your Stables Academy certificate.

Security is open first: ten questions on protecting your Vault key, your payments and yourself. It is the one skill we ask of everyone before real value is at stake.

The five further topics open during the test phase. Questions along the way are welcome in the Academy topic on Telegram below.

Resync

Use this when your bank stays Updating because its built-in node was offline too long to catch up normally.

Stables downloads a validated MegaMMR chain snapshot and searches it for your existing wallet’s coins. Your Vault key, app settings, and local app records stay unchanged. The app restarts when the resync finishes.

The chosen address must run Minima with MegaMMR enabled. Resync replaces only this app’s local blockchain copy. It recovers wallet coins for your existing key, but it cannot reconstruct missing app history or previously untracked script state.

Enter a MegaMMR host and port, for example spartacusrex.com:9001.

      Never share it with anyone.

      Confirmation policy
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      These levels decide when incoming and outgoing transactions are considered complete on this device. Minima blocks are about 30 seconds. Amount thresholds are in MINIMA.
      
                    
                    
      
                        
      
                        
      
                            
                            
                        
      
                    
      
                
      
            
      

            
            
      

                
      
                    
      
                        
      Back up your Vault key
      
                        Not backed up yet
                    
      
                    
      
                        
      Your Vault key (24-word seed phrase) is the only way to recover your funds. No one can recover it for you, not Stables, not Minima.
      
                        
      Only reveal it in a private place. Write it on paper and store it safely. Never type it into a website or share it with anyone.
      
                        
                        
      
                            
      
                            
      
                                
                                
                            
      
                        
      
                    
      
                
      

                
      
                    
      
                        
      Recover a different wallet
      
                    
      
                    
      
                        
      Restoring replaces this device’s wallet with another Vault key and rescans the Minima chain to rediscover its coins. If your current wallet holds funds, back it up first.
      
                        
                        
      Recovery depth
      
                        
                        
      
                            
                            
                            
                        
      
                        
      If your balance looks incomplete after recovery, run Deep recovery. Minima wallets may need additional key-use scanning to rediscover older coins.
      
                        
                        
      
                    
      
                
      

                
      
                    
      
                        
      Keys and signatures
      
                    
      
                    
      
                        
      Minima signs every payment with keys held on this device. Each key can sign a limited number of times (its key-uses), a particularity of Minima’s signature design. If you send very often you can prepare more signing capacity in advance.

      Security (summary)
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      
                        Never share any type of personal information. Beware of scammers: the world is full of them, and particularly the blockchain world. Some Stables users will be scammed and suffer painful losses; we are already sorry for them. We will do our best to educate and prevent this, but users may still suffer losses because of mistakes.
                    
      
                    
      
                        The good news is that if you don’t make any mistakes, you will be just fine. The main one is the protection of your Vault key (called a seed phrase in the broader crypto community): this is the most important element of your bank. You have to store it in a place and in a way that it can’t be destroyed or stolen. The best approach is to replicate it in multiple safe places. Don’t forget: ink on paper fades over the years, so it might not be the best long-term method on its own.
                    
      
                    
      
                        The other main mistake is sharing personal information. Please never communicate any type of personal information. In the Stables framework, no personal information will ever be required, not even your name.
                    
      
                    
      
                        The other big threat is computer viruses and malware. Run your Stables Dapp on a safe device with minimal usage (fewer apps and risks).
                    
      
                    
      
                        In the blockchain world, there is no guaranteed way to catch scammers, and recovering stolen funds is practically impossible.
                    
      
                    
      
                        If you publicly say that you need security help on any official channel, you will almost certainly be contacted across one or multiple communication channels (Telegram, Instagram, X, and others) by sophisticated scammers. We do not know all of their tricks, and they may be better than us at reaching Stables users. Please ignore all unsolicited messages and make sure you never, ever communicate personal information.
                    
      
                    
      
                        We sincerely care for you, and your personal safety is important for the whole community. Every victim impairs trust in our structure. We care for each of us individually because we care for each of us collectively. With all our heart. The Stables Council
                    
      
                    
      
                        Your Vault key controls access to your funds. Never share it.
                        For Vault-key help, ask in the Stables community on Telegram or open Security in Preferences.

      Minima dependencies
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      
                        Minima as the foundation. The Minima blockchain is the basis that holds the whole Stables infrastructure. Together with the physical device on which you run your bank, it is the only physical layer you need to pursue full banking sovereignty. The Stables software on your device is visual and interaction access to your bank: it is how you see balances, sign actions, and move value. At all times, the assets that back your position are anchored in the security model of the Minima network and in the tested Stables infrastructure built on top of it.
                    
      
                    
      
                        Confidence in the chain. We are fully confident that Minima will function soundly across all foreseeable scenarios that matter for this design, because of its decentralised architecture. The only technical impairment that sits with you directly is your own personal device where you open the app: that device is the crux (malware, loss, theft, or user error). On-chain, your funds are continuously protected by Minima’s network security and by Stables’ protocol layer, not by a custodian’s ledger entry.
                    
      
                    
      
                        No corporate affiliation. Stables has no affiliation of any kind with any Minima-related legal entity or with people acting in an official capacity for those organisations. Stables is a separate initiative. References to Minima here mean the public chain and tooling (for example a node or MiniDapp host) and public data (for example price endpoints). They are not a partnership, endorsement, or joint product with those companies.
                    
      
                    
      
                        How open networks work. Public blockchain software is, in large part, open source. Minima-related entities, regulators, governments, and other third parties do not and cannot, by architecture alone, dictate what independent teams build or what you choose to run on your own device. They are not on your device controlling your execution. Control stays with whoever operates the node and the MiniDapp, subject to law and to device security.
                    
      
                    
      
                        Distribution is not the same as sovereignty. An IT company, app store, or other platform may try to limit how you first reach Stables products (for example listings, websites, or policies). Once you have lawfully obtained the software and run it on a sovereign device you control, where no intermediary has technical overreach over your device and your execution, that use does not depend on a central party staying “open” for you. That is why we say unstoppable in this technical sense: the design does not require a single gatekeeper for your bank on your own machine.
                    
      
                    
      
                        Seizure and blocking. When you self-custody and interact without a custodian holding your funds, there is no single technical lever a third party can flip to freeze your bank or to block peer-to-peer interactions with other banks the way a centralised account provider can suspend access. This describes what the architecture avoids compared to custodial finance. It does not remove every real-world risk (devices can be lost, stolen, compromised, or subject to lawful process). It is not legal advice.
                    
      
                
      
            
      
            
            
      
                
      
                    
      Prices and rates
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      
                        There is no price in this test. Winiwa and xWiniwa are
                        test tokens with no value. They are not money, they are
                        not an investment, and they cannot be redeemed for anything. Nothing here is financial or
                        legal advice.
                    
      
                    
      
                        Mint and burn are at par. One Winiwa becomes one
                        xWiniwa, and one xWiniwa becomes one Winiwa, in either direction. That rate is fixed by the
                        on-chain covenant, not chosen by this app and not read from any market. There is
                        no price feed, no rate oracle and no signed price in
                        this release.
                    
      
                    
      
                        Stablecoins such as USDw, the fiat display currencies,
                        and every market or trading surface are not part of this
                        test. The wider protocol design covers them, but none of it is deployed here, so no
                        conversion rate for them exists in this build.
                    
      
                
      
            
      
            
      
                
      
                    
      Privacy Policy (summary)
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      
                        This preview stores some choices on your device (for example
                        layout and preferences in browser storage). Neither Stables nor Minima has any visibility into that local data for this static preview; we do not receive it from this copy alone. On the other hand, we cannot guarantee that other actors, such as the company that provides your device operating system or other software on your device, do not have technical means to access device storage or settings. Please do not enter sensitive information where it could be exposed. Do not send secrets or Vault keys through unofficial channels; use only the official Council and
                        security contacts listed on the links page and on Security in this app.

                        properties.

      Connect your Minima node
      
            
      
            
      
                
      
                    !
                    
                        Not connected
                        Enter the RPC address of the Minima node you want Stables to use.
                    
                
      
                
      
                    Connection
                    
                    
                    
                
      
                
      
                    
      This Stables app has no node of its own. It asks the Minima Core already on this phone, and Core keeps your wallet, your node and your permissions.
      
                    
      You do not install Stables into Core. Opening this app registers it with Core by itself; what is left is to say yes to it, twice, inside Core.
      
                    
        
                        
      1. Open Minima Core and find StablesIn Core, go to Apps. Stables appears there once this app has been opened at least once. If it is missing, open this app again and go back.
        2. 
                        
      2. Enable itCore will not answer Stables until you allow it. Stables cannot do this for you.
        3. 
                        
      3. Allow Admin, to move fundsBalances load without it. Mint, Burn and Send need Core to sign, and only Admin permits that. Core shows its own full-access warning first, which is Core asking, not Stables.
        4. 
                    
      
                
      
                
      
                    
      Stables reads balances and sends transactions through your node. Only connect to a node you control because RPC can access its wallet.
      
                    
      
                        
                        
                        
      RPC is normally your node port + 4. For a node on 9201, use http://127.0.0.1:9205.
      
                    
      
                    
      
                        
                        
                        
      This is only needed when your RPC endpoint is password protected.

                Is your Vault key backed up?
            
      
            
      
                
      Your Vault key is your ONLY access to your bank. No one can recover it for you, including Stables or Minima.
      
                
      The Stables community can help with questions; only you can keep your key safe.

      Recover an existing bank
      
            
            

            
      
                
      
                or
                
      
            
      

            
        
      
    
      

    
    
      
        
      
            
      Replace this bank?
      
            
      
                
      This replaces the bank on this device with the Vault key you entered, then rescans to find its money.
      
                
      If your current bank holds money, make sure it is backed up first, otherwise it could be lost forever.
      
            
      
            
      
                
            
      
        
      
    
      

    
    
      
        
      
            
      Quick safety check
      
            
      Two quick questions before you replace your bank. This keeps your money safe.
      
            
      
                
      1. If you lose your 24-word Vault key, who can recover your money for you?
      
                
      
                    
                    
                    
                
      
                
      
            
      
            
      
                
      2. Before replacing this bank, how do you protect any money it holds?
      
                
      
                    
                    
                    
                
      
                
      
            
      
            
            
      
                
            
      
        
      
    
      

    
    
      
        
      
            
      
            
      Recovering your bank
      
            
      
                
      Recovery restarts your bank, and the app relaunches on its own.
      
                
      Keep the app open. It rescans to find your money, which can take a few minutes. When it returns to your bank, your balance is restored. Older transactions may not reappear straight away; new activity shows from here.
      
            
      
        
      
    
      

    
    
      
        
      
            
      Danger: node terminal
      
            
      
                
      This runs commands directly on your node, the engine that holds your wallet.
      
                
      A wrong or malicious command can move or lose your funds, expose your Vault key, or corrupt your wallet.
      
                
      Only continue if you know exactly what you are doing. Never run a command someone else gave you.
